Strata Projects · device-location-checking

The WiFi environment is the one signal a VPN cannot move

An employee can route traffic through a California exit node from anywhere. They cannot change which access points their laptop can hear. WiFi BSSID geolocation is the only CRITICAL-weighted path; the other ten indicators corroborate it or stand in when WiFi is unavailable.

Built February 2026 Version 1.1.0 Primary target Windows 10/11 Status internal testing

01 The problem

Consumer VPN exit nodes defeat IP-based location checks.

State of California employees under a geographic work requirement can install NordVPN, ExpressVPN or similar, select a California exit node, and present a compliant source IP from any physical location. A second class of case is harder: the VPN runs on the home router, so nothing is installed on the endpoint at all.

California is tested as a bounding box: latitude 32.53 to 42.01, longitude -124.48 to -114.13.

02 Detection paths

Eleven indicators, run in one pass. Ten score; latency is reported only.

#PathConfidenceWhat it reads
1WiFi BSSID geolocationCriticalNearby access point MAC addresses resolved to a physical fix through Google's database
2Timezone vs IP mismatchHighSystem timezone against the timezone of the source IP
3Source IP ASN classificationHighWhether the egress IP belongs to a known VPN provider or a datacenter
4Network hop analysisHighTraceroute to the first public hop, to catch a VPN running on the router
5Virtual network adaptersHighTAP, Wintun, WireGuard, NordLynx interfaces
6VPN client processesHighRunning processes matched against a provider list
7Registry software scanHighInstalled VPN software, present even when not running
8DNS configurationMediumResolvers belonging to VPN providers
9Routing table anomaliesMediumThe full-tunnel split-default pattern
10Windows Location ServicesMediumThe OS's own WiFi/GPS fix, resolved to city and state
11Latency analysisReportedRound-trip timing to fixed endpoints; carries zero points
Router-level VPN

Paths 4 and the WiFi-versus-IP comparison exist for the case where the endpoint is clean. A physical fix inside California with an egress IP in a datacenter ASN, or the reverse, is the signal; nothing needs to be installed on the laptop for it to fire.

03 Tools and data sources

PowerShell is the product. The Python and Swift tools exist to prove the API path on other platforms.

Scripts

FilePlatformScope

How BSSIDs are collected

Windows   netsh wlan show networks mode=bssid
Linux     nmcli  (fallback: iwlist, may need sudo)
macOS     CoreWLAN via the Swift scanner, requires Location Services

External services

ServiceRoleNote
googleapis.com/geolocation/v1/geolocateBSSID → lat/longThe paid dependency, ~$5 per 1,000 requests
ip-api.com/jsonIP geolocation, ASNFree tier, no key
ipinfo.io/jsonIP geolocation, ASNSecond opinion on the egress IP
nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverseReverse geocodeTurns a fix into city and state for the report

The Geolocation API is enabled on GCP project prod-kzmo157frhxj. The key is read from GOOGLE_GEOLOCATION_API_KEY in the environment, from a .env beside the script, or from an interactive prompt.

04 Confidence rating

Additive points out of 300, mapped to four bands and four exit codes.

60
Points for a physical WiFi fix outside California, the single heaviest indicator
100
Score at which the verdict becomes CRITICAL
300
Maximum possible score

Weights

IndicatorPointsConfidence
WiFi geolocation outside California60Critical
WiFi fix and IP location disagree50High
Router VPN detected on first hop50High
IP in a datacenter or VPN range40High
IP in a known VPN provider ASN40High
Windows Location Services outside California40Medium
VPN adapters present35High
VPN processes running35High
Timezone mismatch30High
VPN software installed30High
Suspicious network path25Medium
Full-tunnel routing pattern25Medium
VPN DNS configuration20Medium

Bands

ScoreVerdictExit codeMeaning
100+Critical3Spoofing almost certain
70–99High2Strong evidence
40–69Medium1Needs human review
0–39Low0No clear indication
Two scoring models exist

The earlier WiFi-only script uses a five-indicator scale out of 150 with thresholds at 80 and 50. Only the full script uses the table above. Comparing a score from one against the bands of the other gives the wrong verdict.

05 Deployment methods

Three ways to run it, all from one PowerShell file. No agent, no installer, no server component.

MethodHowFor
Double-clickRun-VPN-Detection.bat, which calls PowerShell with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass and pauses on the resultA non-technical user running it on their own machine. 30–60 seconds, coloured console report
Interactive shell.\vpn-location-detection-full.ps1, with -SkipWifi or -SkipPreflight as neededAn investigator working the machine directly. Preflight checks guide through a missing key or adapter
Machine-readable-OutputJson, or Run-VPN-Detection-JSON.bat. Verdict also lands in the process exit codeAnything that collects results centrally. The exit code is the integration surface

Requirements at the endpoint

  • Windows 10 or 11, PowerShell 5.1 or later. PowerShell 7 compatibility was fixed in v1.1.0.
  • Administrator rights recommended; the registry scan and some adapter queries need them.
  • A WiFi adapter for the critical path. Without one, run -SkipWifi and the ceiling drops to the corroborating indicators.
  • Outbound internet to the four services in section 03.
Not built

There is no silent, scheduled or fleet-wide delivery. No Intune or SCCM package, no GPO startup script, no Cortex XDR script-execution wrapper, and no collection point for the JSON. Every run today is a person running it on one machine.

06 Scope and limitations

  • macOS cannot carry the critical path. macOS 12+ withholds BSSIDs from command-line tools. The Swift scanner needs Location Services granted, and even then does not work in every scenario. Windows is the only platform where the tool performs as designed.
  • Google's database has to know the access points. A rural or newly deployed WiFi environment can return no fix, which reads as absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
  • Ethernet-only endpoints lose the heaviest indicator. No WiFi adapter means no BSSID fix, and the maximum achievable score falls accordingly.
  • The score is an investigative trigger. A datacenter ASN or a VPN client is lawful on a personal machine; the tool ranks cases for review, it does not establish that a policy was broken.
  • Two internal packages ship a live API key. They are gitignored and were never meant to leave the team. Any wider distribution uses the v1.1.0 package and a per-recipient key.
  • Last touched February 2026. Seven commits, no activity since; treat version 1.1.0 as the state of the work.
